hero.subhead: Turnkey solar EPC for industrial and commercial facilities across Bangladesh. From high-efficiency rooftop PV arrays to hybrid microgrids, BTEL lowers operating energy costs up to 40% with clean energy.

systemTypes.heading: Tailored System Architecture
systemTypes.intro: We design and commission solar solutions engineered specifically for your load profile — select a configuration to see the products behind it.

cards.title: On-Grid Solar
cards.description: Grid-connected solar power systems that export excess energy and reduce your utility bill. Ideal for factories, commercial buildings and institutions with a reliable grid supply.

cards.title: Off-Grid Solar
cards.description: Standalone solar power systems with battery storage for locations without grid access. Provides 24/7 clean energy independence in remote industrial and agricultural sites.

cards.title: Hybrid Solar
cards.description: Combines grid connection with battery storage for maximum resilience. Automatically switches power sources to ensure zero downtime — ideal for mission-critical operations.

features.heading: Turnkey Solar / Renewable Projects
features.intro: From the first site survey to the final watt delivered — BTEL manages every phase of your solar project.

cards.title: Revolutionary Solar Power Plants
cards.description: Harnessing solar energy efficiently to deliver optimum energy solutions for industrial, commercial and institutional clients across Bangladesh.

cards.title: Cutting Edge Technology & Operations
cards.description: We design, develop and implement on-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar power plants using globally proven equipment and signature operations management systems.

cards.title: Future Integration & Environmental Responsibility
cards.description: Turnkey solutions advancing sustainability and carbon neutrality through solar power — aligning with Bangladesh's national renewable energy targets and global ESG commitments.

cards.title: Partner in Development & a Friend in Need
cards.description: Construction, maintenance, and troubleshooting powered by aerial surveillance and simulations to meet the energy demand of today and tomorrow.

process.heading: The BTEL Solar EPC Process
process.intro: Five structured phases from concept to commissioning — delivered on time, every time.

steps.title: Site Survey & Yield Analysis
steps.description: Shading analysis, structural roof checks, and solar irradiance simulation.

steps.title: System Engineering & Design
steps.description: Single line diagrams, component selection, structural sizing, net metering planning.

steps.title: Procurement & Import
steps.description: Tier-1 solar modules, string/central inverters, mounting structure, protection hardware.

steps.title: Installation & Interconnection
steps.description: Mechanical mounting, DC/AC cabling, inverter setup, grid synchronisation.

steps.title: Testing, Commissioning & O&M
steps.description: Performance ratio testing, grid authority sign-off, ongoing monitoring & AMC.
